metadata.case_name: NG KUK CHAI v. BECKING INVESTMENT LIMITED

injuries.description: very mild head injury with post-concussional syndrome
source: I accept from the evidence that she suffered from a very mild head injury with post-concussional syndrome but without any indication for regular neurological treatment; a mild depressive episode; and, at least for a period of time up to the operation in November 2006, some form of diplopia.

injuries.description: exotropia (divergent squint) / diplopia; underwent operation of both eyes lateral rectus recession on 8 November 2006
source: According to the report of the Department of Ophthalmology of the Hospital, Ng had visited the said department on 18 August 2006 with a complaint of diplopia after sustaining an injury in December 2005. An examination was conducted which showed exotropia (divergent squint). An operation of both eyes lateral rectus recession was performed on 8 November 2006.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

source: Ng claims that her head hit the floor as she fell, and her left thigh was scalded.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: complaint of a large quantity of 'yellowish brain fluid' flowing from left nostril (alleged cerebrospinal fluid leak)
diplopia (double vision) / monocular and binocular diplopia (reported)

treatments_received: admitted to the Department of Neurosurgery at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital; CT scan of the brain showed no hemorrhage or skull fracture; discharged on 31 December 2005
treatments_future: 15 sessions of psychological treatment / further psychological counselling as recommended by experts

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA)
